videos.desc:
Join us for the 2nd Annual KY POTA Campout!

We had a such a great time this year, and next year will be even better. 

🗓️ Save the date: *24-26 SEP 2027*
🏕️ Location: *Taylorsville Lake SP (US-1271)*

*Find all the information on our website* https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/campout.html

Tell your friends - Share the flyer!  https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/KPC_2027_KYPOTA_Campout_Flyer.pdf
